tests.title: AC-19101-1: rcf audit separation over test-author, builder and verifier commits on their own paths exits 0 and prints "separation: PASS 3 commits (base <sha7>, head <sha7>): test-author 1, builder 1, verifier 1, stage-keeper 0, neutral 0, undeclared 0, exceptions 0"

AC-19101-2: rcf audit separation with a Hand: builder commit touching test/x.test.js exits 4 and prints "separation: FAIL 1 of <n> commits (base <sha7>, head <sha7>): <sha7> Hand=builder touches test/x.test.js"

AC-19101-2: rcf audit separation classes a test file with more than one extension after .test. or .spec. as test: Hand: builder touching src/widget.test.d.ts or src/widget.spec.js.map exits 4 with the FAIL line, Hand: test-author touching it passes

AC-19101-2: rcf audit separation classes lockfiles of every common ecosystem as neutral: a Hand: test-author commit touching only package-lock.json, npm-shrinkwrap.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, yarn.lock, bun.lockb, bun.lock, Cargo.lock, Gemfile.lock, poetry.lock, uv.lock, composer.lock, go.sum or any basename ending .lock passes
AC-19101-3: rcf audit separation passes undeclared commits touching only src/ or only test/ and counts them undeclared; an undeclared commit touching both exits 4 naming both paths

AC-19101-4: rcf audit separation --base <missing-ref> exits 2 with "separation: bad ref <ref>"; outside a git repository it exits 1 with "separation: not a git repository"; an unknown Hand value is a violation "unknown hand <value>"
AC-19101-5: rcf audit separation --json prints a JSON array of one SeparationRow { sha, subject, hand, declared, classes, verdict, reason, paths } per non-merge commit with merge commits absent
AC-19101-6: rcf audit separation writes no file, reads no network and no chain: two runs over the same range print byte-identical output and leave git status unchanged
AC-19101-7: rcf audit separation classifies a committed report under rcf/verify-reports/ as verifier evidence
